section_summary.extract_value: This section describes use of the Malay translation of the Sociocultural Attitudes Toward Appearance Questionnaire-3 (SATAQ-3), noting that only the first two subscales (Pressure/Internalisation-General and Information) were administered and that subscale scores were computed as item means. It reports internal consistency (omega = .90 for Pressure/Internalisation-General and .71 for Information) and explains that the newer SATAQ-4 has not been translated for Malay-speaking populations. The section does not provide participant sample size, demographics, recruitment source, BMI data, or correlations with body appreciation.
section_summary.evidence_source:
'All participants were asked to complete the Sociocultural Attitudes Toward Appearance Questionnaire-3 (SATAQ-3; Thompson, ...; Malay translation: Swami, 2009).'
'In the present study, participants were only asked to complete the former two subscales of the Malay SATAQ-3 and subscale scores were computed as the mean of all relevant items.'
'In the present study, omega was .90 (95% CI = .88-.91) for Pressure and Internalisation-General and .71 (95% CI = .68-.74) for Information.'
